name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
description: Canonical app origin for links, QR redirects, Stripe return URLs, and local development.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
description: Public Supabase project URL used by browser and server clients.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
description: Supabase anon key safe for browser usage with Row Level Security.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
description: Stripe publishable key used by client-side Stripe flows.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
description: Optional restricted browser key for Google Maps JavaScript API and Places API (New) venue autocomplete.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
description: Optional Sentry DSN used for privacy-minimised browser and server error capture.

name: ANALYTICS_EXTERNAL_PROCESSING_MODE
description: Optional external analytics mode. PostHog processing is disabled unless this is exactly pseudonymous.

name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_KEY
description: Optional server-only PostHog project key used only when pseudonymous external processing is enabled.

name: POSTHOG_HOST
description: Optional server-only PostHog ingestion host used only when pseudonymous external processing is enabled.

name: ANALYTICS_PSEUDONYM_SECRET
description: Optional dedicated high-entropy HMAC secret for server-side external analytics pseudonyms.

name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
description: Privileged Supabase service-role key for trusted server-side jobs only.

name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
description: Optional Postgres connection URL used only for applying migrations, seeding fixtures, and running SQL RLS tests.

name: SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD
description: Optional database password used with linked Supabase pooler metadata when SUPABASE_DB_URL is not set.

name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
description: Stripe secret key for server-side billing and portal calls.

name: STRIPE_GROWTH_PRICE_ID
description: Stripe recurring Price ID for the Growth Plan at GBP 49/month.

name: STRIPE_GROWTH_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID
description: Stripe recurring Price ID for the Growth Plan annual option at GBP 490/year (2 months free). Optional for local boot and required by the production release profile.

name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify webhook requests.

name: RESEND_API_KEY
description: Resend API key for transactional email from trusted server code.

name: RESEND_FROM
description: Verified Resend sender for Supabase Send Email auth hook messages, e.g. 'Nabaperks <login@nabaperks.com>'. Used for merchant/admin email auth.

name: NON_PRODUCTION_DELIVERY_HMAC_SECRET
description: Optional high-entropy HMAC secret for exact hosted Preview/Staging delivery-destination approval. Delivery remains disabled there unless this and NON_PRODUCTION_DELIVERY_ALLOWLIST are both valid.

name: NON_PRODUCTION_DELIVERY_ALLOWLIST
description: Optional comma-separated hosted Preview/Staging destination fingerprints in channel:base64url-HMAC form, where channel is email, sms, or web-push. Contains no raw contact PII.

name: WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
description: Optional VAPID public key for browser Web Push subscription requests. Exposed only through the public-key route.

name: WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
description: Optional VAPID private key used by trusted server-side Web Push delivery workers.

name: WEB_PUSH_VAPID_SUBJECT
description: Optional VAPID subject, usually a mailto: or HTTPS contact URI, used by server-side Web Push delivery.

name: CRON_SECRET
description: Optional bearer token for protected Vercel Cron and manual scheduled worker invocations.

name: PRODUCTION_MONITOR_SECRET
description: Dedicated high-entropy bearer token for the production dependency-readiness monitor.

name: PRODUCTION_MONITOR_SECRET_NEXT
description: Optional high-entropy overlap token used only for zero-downtime production monitor-secret rotation; remove it after cutover.

name: SENTRY_DSN
description: Optional server-only Sentry DSN override.

name: SENTRY_ORG
description: Optional Sentry organization slug for release and source-map association.

name: SENTRY_PROJECT
description: Optional Sentry project slug linked to the Nabaperks GitHub repository.

name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
description: Optional Sentry build token used only to upload production source maps.

name: NABAPERKS_FEATURE_PLATFORM_ERROR_REPORTING
description: Feature-flag override for server-side error reporting; true enables and false disables capture.

name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
description: Twilio Account SID used by customer Twilio Verify phone OTPs and any legacy Supabase SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
description: Optional Twilio Auth Token used by direct customer Twilio Verify API calls. If omitted, TWILIO_API_KEY_SID and TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET are required.

name: TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID
description: Twilio Verify Service SID used for customer phone OTP start/check flows.

name: CUSTOMER_OTP_BYPASS_MODE
description: Temporary emergency customer OTP bypass. Set to any-4-digits to skip Twilio Verify and approve exactly four-digit customer OTP checks; leave blank to require Twilio Verify.

name: CUSTOMER_SESSION_SECRET
description: High-entropy secret for signing first-party customer pending-phone and 30-day session cookies.

name: CUSTOMER_PHONE_HMAC_SECRET
description: High-entropy secret for deterministic HMAC lookup of verified customer phone numbers.

name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL_HMAC_SECRET
description: High-entropy secret for deterministic HMAC matching of pending reward-invite email addresses (never stored raw). Optional at the env level so the rest of the app runs without it; required only to send/match email invites, enforced at call time in lib/customer/email-pii-core.ts.

name: CUSTOMER_PHONE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: High-entropy key material used to derive AES-GCM encryption keys for stored customer phone ciphertext.

name: MERCHANT_OTP_ALIAS_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: High-entropy key material used to derive AES-GCM keys for merchant email OTP alias tokens at rest (auth otp alias token encryption). Optional at the env level so the app boots without it; alias CREATION fails closed at call time in lib/security/otp-alias-token-core.ts, so set it before deploying the encryption change or merchant email-code login cannot mint new codes.

name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SID
description: Twilio API key SID for customer Twilio Verify OTPs when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is not set, and for legacy Supabase Send SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET
description: Twilio API key secret for customer Twilio Verify OTPs when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is not set, and for legacy Supabase Send SMS hook usage.

name: TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
description: Legacy Twilio Messaging Service SID for the Supabase Send SMS auth hook. Not used by customer OTP.

name: SUPABASE_SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET
description: Standard Webhooks signing secret (v1,whsec_...) for the Supabase send-email auth hook. Must match the secret configured in the Supabase dashboard.

name: SUPABASE_SEND_SMS_HOOK_SECRET
description: Legacy Standard Webhooks signing secret for the Supabase Send SMS auth hook. Customer OTP does not use this hook.

name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: High-entropy key material used to derive the AES-GCM key for bulk loyalty-invitation recipient email ciphertext at rest. Optional at the env level so the app boots without it; required only to run invitation campaigns, enforced at call time in lib/customer/email-encryption-core.ts.

name: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
description: Svix/Standard-Webhooks signing secret (whsec_...) for the Resend delivery webhook (delivered/bounced/complained/failed). Optional at the env level; the webhook fails closed at call time when unset.
